plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026) — T18 Watch complete, steps 2-3 (registry, engine, pull carriers) and step 8 (the public site)
runtime: node 22, express, PostgreSQL 18 (openvibe-sdk/db, async) + Valkey 9, fast-xml-parser
domain: openvibe.watch (a public server-rendered site + a loopback-only API; vhost in deploy/nginx; README "Public site" and "Public host")
deployment: Not deployed. Plan T18 steps 2-3 and step 8 are implemented and tested in the repository; nothing runs on the host yet, and openvibe.watch has no DNS or vhost installed.
works: the watch registry with owner scoping (404 for another owner) validated against the released contracts
the check engine: conditional GET (ETag/Last-Modified, HEAD-first for change-only), 304/unchanged-body short circuits, recorded states, backoff and Retry-After
SSRF-guarded fetching (ports, private hosts, every redirect hop, byte cap, one deadline) and per-host spacing
the http, feed (RSS/Atom) and api carriers
extraction (text, html, css subset, json/jsonpath, regex) and conditions (changed/threshold/string, for_sec)
observations with value hashes, capped snapshots and retention; check runs with the full state set
the loopback-only API (one capability per route), watch.* events through the transactional outbox, per-actor limits

the public site: sign-in with OpenVibe.Network (OAuth2 + PKCE S256, sessions in Watch's database), the home page and four starting points, /watches (paged), the create and edit forms (server-side fieldsets, validation errors that keep the input), one watch with pause/resume/delete/check-now, the observation history and check runs, /how-it-works, /updates, and robots/sitemap/llms.txt
the site calls the registry in-process with the API's ownership rules (another person's watch is 404 on every page and form) and refuses cross-site writes
notYet: not deployed: no host install, DNS or vhost on openvibe.watch yet, so nothing is reachable in production
no check has run against a real external site from a deployed service (the tests use stub sites only)
the event and webhook carriers (step 5), the Run rung (step 6), Node probes (step 7) and the actions (step 4): a watch of such a kind is accepted but never fetched
an ai extraction is not a check (step 10); such a watch is recorded skipped and nothing is fetched
the site offers only page/price/feed/json watches: the kinds and the AI reading above are not in the form
notifications are the watch.watch.triggered event OpenVibe.Network turns into WATCH_TRIGGERED; no other action is dispatched
features: watch registry with owner scoping (404 for another owner) validated against the released contracts
binding carrier preference order: webhook/event → ETag/Last-Modified → feed → API → Run
conditional GET: If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since, HEAD-first when only change is needed, 304 and unchanged-body short circuits
SSRF-guarded fetcher (ports, private hosts, every redirect hop, byte cap, one deadline) and per-host spacing
extraction: text, html, css subset, json/jsonpath, regex; ai refused as a later step
conditions: changed/threshold with tolerance and percent, for_sec debounce over the observation trail
observations with value hashes, capped snapshots and retention
check runs with the full terminal-state set, exponential backoff and Retry-After
POST /api/v1/watches/:id/check plus the observations and checks reads
watch.* events through the outbox in the same transaction as the state change

the public site: Network sign-in (PKCE S256, web_sessions with only the token hash), server-rendered pages complete without JavaScript, the four create templates, watch management, observation history and check runs, how-it-works and the changelog, robots/sitemap/llms.txt
